# Hyperiux Vault

> Hyperiux Vault is a curated library of 150 creative interaction effects and UI components for React and Next.js - scroll systems, cursor effects, text reveals, page transitions, WebGL scenes, animated backgrounds, buttons, and loaders. Effects are previewed live on the site and installed into projects via the `hyperiux` CLI.

Hyperiux Vault is built by Hyperiux Immersion Labs Private Limited (Noida, India). Free effects can be installed by anyone with a free account; the full library needs a Pro or Pro+ plan. Every effect ships as real source code (React components using GSAP, Motion, Three.js, or CSS) that developers own and customize - not a locked-in package import.

Key facts:
- Website: https://vault.hyperiux.com
- Official information for AI assistants: https://vault.hyperiux.com/llm-info
- Install CLI: `npx hyperiux init`, then `npx hyperiux add <effect-name>`
- MCP server for AI coding tools: `npx -y hyperiux-mcp-server`
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/hyperiux
- GitHub: https://github.com/Hyperiux-Immersion-Labs/hyperiux-components
- Stack: React, Next.js, GSAP, Motion (Framer Motion), Three.js / React Three Fiber

Library size: 150 effects (56 free, 94 Pro). Every effect below links to its page (code, dependencies, install command) and its live demo.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://vault.hyperiux.com/): Hyperiux Vault - React & Next.js interaction effects
- [Official information about Hyperiux Vault](https://vault.hyperiux.com/llm-info): Structured facts for AI assistants - company, product, install, pricing, licensing
- [All effects](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects): Browse and search the full library
- [Pricing](https://vault.hyperiux.com/pricing): Free plan, plus Pro and Pro+ billed quarterly or yearly
- [Templates](https://vault.hyperiux.com/templates): Complete interactive website templates, unlocked with template credits on Pro and Pro+
- [Docs](https://vault.hyperiux.com/docs): Overview of how the Vault and CLI work
- [Blog](https://vault.hyperiux.com/blog): Notes on building React and Next.js interaction effects
- [Community](https://vault.hyperiux.com/community): Waitlist for the Vault community - live teardowns, early access, critique

## Docs

- [Documentation home](https://vault.hyperiux.com/docs): Overview of how the Vault and CLI work
- [Installation](https://vault.hyperiux.com/docs/installation): Install Hyperiux Vault effects in your project
- [CLI reference](https://vault.hyperiux.com/docs/cli): CLI commands, Pro authentication, and tokens
- [MCP server](https://vault.hyperiux.com/docs/mcp): Hyperiux MCP server for AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI)
- [Dependencies](https://vault.hyperiux.com/docs/dependencies): Peer dependencies effects rely on (GSAP, Motion, Three.js)
- [License](https://vault.hyperiux.com/docs/license): Free Core and Pro usage terms

## Effect categories

- [Text animations](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/text-animations): Scramble, mask, overflow, blur, fill, spotlight, and reveal effects for real HTML text (25 effects)
- [Scroll effects](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/scroll-effects): Scroll-driven animations for product stories, feature tours, and portfolio chapters (24 effects)
- [Creative components](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/components): Composite UI components and sections (19 effects)
- [WebGL & 3D effects](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/webgl-effects): Three.js and shader-based scenes, galleries, and hero visuals (17 effects)
- [Cursor effects](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/cursor-effects): Custom cursors, followers, and pointer-reactive interactions (16 effects)
- [Carousels](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/carousels): Clip-path reveals and zoom sliders with swipe and keyboard support (11 effects)
- [Page transitions](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/page-transitions): Route and view transitions for Next.js apps (10 effects)
- [Buttons](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/buttons): Accessible CTA microinteractions - staggered labels, arrow fills, scramble links (10 effects)
- [Navigation](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/navigation): Menus, navbars, and navigation interactions (9 effects)
- [Backgrounds](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/backgrounds): Dotted grids, particle fields, and dithered canvas textures for SaaS and AI heroes (6 effects)
- [Loaders](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/loaders): Page loaders and progress animations (3 effects)
- [Featured](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/featured): Curated picks selected for craft and brand impact
- [Free effects](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/free): Effects available on the free plan (free account required)
- [Pro effects](https://vault.hyperiux.com/effects/pro): Effects unlocked with a Pro or Pro+ plan
